articles.title: Starling build agentic fincrime investigator that takes 17 seconds
articles.summary: Starling has deployed an agentic "financial crime investigator" that the UK digital bank says can carry out an end-to-end investigation within 17 seconds.

articles.title: Visa pilots AI agent payments between buyer and supplier platforms
articles.summary: Visa has joined forces with Bill and Billtrust to launch the first live pilot to enable trusted AI agents to initiate and complete approved buyer invoice payments end-to-end through supplier portals.

articles.title: ScribeUp raises $13m for AI-powered bill management
articles.summary: ScribeUp, the AI-powered embedded recurring bill solution for modern financial institutions, today announced its Series A fundraise of $13 million. The round was led by Curql, with participation from Mucker Capital and Service Ventures.

articles.title: Versana and Allvue partner to modernise loan market data connectivity and automation
articles.summary: Versana LLC (“Versana”), an industry-backed enterprise data and digital infrastructure company for the broadly syndicated loan (BSL) and private credit markets, and Allvue Systems, LLC (“Allvue”), a leading technology provider for private capital markets, today announced a strategic partnership connecting Versana’s centralized digital data platform with Allvue’s trade order management and investment accounting solutions to transform interoperability and scalability across the $9 trillion BSL and private credit markets.

articles.title: Mastercard demonstrates tech that helps agents pay for digital services
articles.summary: At Cloudflare Connect, Mastercard is showing how Agent Pay for Machines helps AI agents pay for digital services while keeping people and businesses in control.

articles.title: Evervault launches Browser Tokens, enabling secure agentic payments
articles.summary: Evervault today announced the launch of Browser Tokens at Money20/20, giving developers building agentic commerce products a secure way for AI agents and browser automations to make purchases, log in to accounts and complete sensitive online workflows without exposing payment cards, passwords or personal data to the agent or browser provider.

articles.title: Agentic AI and Instant Payments: How Can Banks Reduce Fragmentation?
articles.summary: At Sibos 2026, the Euro Banking Association shares the ways in which banks can combat agentic AI disintermediation and reduce European payment fragmentation. How agentic AI could reshape bank brands and customer loyalty.
